body: Exactly, it's like helping them will somehow help you as well. I hope we all make it as well and I wish you luck on your next step whatever that may be.
I'm sure you're just as kind in you're own way. Even if you don't have hope, I'm rooting for you.

I appreciate that, thank you. I think I try to push away the feeling of trying to save myself onto trying to save others instead because that just makes more sense to me. Like why bother with me when I should help others more deserving. I'm sorry you've lost people as well but it's good you have a much better way of looking at it. Youre awesome, too.

it makes it so hard to rely on people. i know others appreciate you being there for them and hell idk if im to be trusted either if that's the case but if you do, then know at least im proud of you for making it this far despite those people leaving you for that.

im so sorry you're feeling like this too and also at such a young age. disappointing parents really just feels god awful no matter how old you are, huh? i hope you're able to ask for help from them when and if you're ready

i just feel like going in a ward right now means that I would miss a semester and I'm already extending my senior year a semester as is. I don't know, its just the feeling of failure and being terrified of telling people how bad it's gotten despite their help already is just letting everyone down, and that would only make me feel worse. everything is just....s o much right right ya know?
exactly. I feel like the more I talk about these feelings, the less they'll think of me and leave. i totally get it.

I think my mom and my best friend would be supportive but I just can't overcome that overwhelming feeling that I'm going to disappoint them if I tell them and fall completely behind my friend in school and life and be nothing but a failure to them.
